messages:
ray: FYI noticed a few tenants showing *lower* invoice previews today. Noticed a cluster of 'missing' session credits. Anyone else?

nina: I saw that too. Traced to ingest: several requests have been suppressed at dedupe and never counted. Looks recent, started after clientlib v2 roll.

carter: interesting. clientlib v2 tightened idempotency semantics: the idempotency token is now scoped to (client_id + session_id) instead of global event_id to reduce duplicate processing in mobile SDKs. That was intended.

ray: AV capture: example event_id e-98123 - originally we would fingerprint on event_id and accept one appearance. After v2, token scope collapsed multiple distinct events in a session into one, dropping legitimate events.

nina: so this is undercounting (missing tokens) not double-counting. That's new territory for metering. Billing previews pulled from ingest counts so previews lower. Final invoices may also be lower unless we replay.

billing-bot: [auto] Created ticket BILL-901: idempotency-scope-regression. Linked sample tenant 7012 and event_ids.

carter: root cause: SDK set idempotency-key header to session-scoped value for convenience. Server dedupe looked at idempotency-key if present and suppressed duplicates. Previously we relied on client-supplied idempotency only as best-effort and always used event_id. Now we prefer idempotency header which changed semantics.

ops: can we revert server behavior quickly to prefer event_id over client idempotency header?

nina: yes, short term mitigation: server-side dedupe precedence change - use event_id when present, fall back to idempotency header. That will restore counts immediately for events with unique event_id. Low risk and quick.

carter: agree. Also we should push a clientlib patch to change idempotency-key semantics for v2 to include event_id when available (idempotency = sha(session_id + event_id)) so it remains session-friendly but unique per event.

ray: telemetry ask: we need a panel showing dedupe.suppressed_count_by_scope (values: event_id, client_id_session) and invoice.preview.delta_by_tenant so CS can triage.

billing-bot: Suggest adding alert: if dedupe.suppressed_count_by_scope(client_id_session) rises >1000/min across tenants for >5m, page oncall.

carter: rollout plan:
- immediate: hotfix server dedupe precedence to event_id-first (hotfix patch deploy in 30m)
- next: clientlib v2 patch to append event_id to idempotency-key (release + notify partners)
- telemetry: add suppression-by-scope and preview delta dashboards (nina)
- follow-up: run backfill for suppressed events where we can recover payloads (need to check retention)

ops: one caveat: changing dedupe precedence may momentarily reveal true duplicates we previously suppressed and could cause small invoice bumps. Need to warn finance/CS.

ray: good point. I'll draft an incident note for finance and CS explaining expected delta window and mitigation steps (replay/backfill).

nina: PRs: server hotfix ready, will target canary in us-east then global if no regressions. Telemetry panels in progress.

carter: clientlib patch will be targeted next minor release. I'll coordinate with SDK leads to include migration notes.

ops: oncall rota: @ray @nina watch the canary for 3 hours after deploy. ops-bot will post canary channel.

billing-bot: [auto] Added action items: BILL-901 (engineers), CONS-501 (console telemetry), CS-190 (customer comms).

ray: thanks team. let's keep changes minimal and monitor metrics closely.
